source: isolated real-data schema-30 database from p18n rehearsal
interpretation: The batch selected at most 20 unresolved candidates from each of 56 topics.
Some topics contained fewer than 20 candidates, so the batch has 1092 rather than 1120 members.
The existing rejected assignment was not eligible because its effective state at the frozen review cutoff was rejected.
No human decision was created by sampling, so every selected member remains pending and acceptance_bps is null.
The sample estimates candidate precision only after review; it does not measure recall or authorize publication.
limitations: The rehearsal created a batch in an isolated Mac copy only.
Windows and production data were not changed.
The batch still requires individual evidence review through the append-only review ledger.
No automatic or bulk acceptance operation exists.
